VinCRIStine: IV push over 1 minute (or infusion via minibag as per institution policy)
1.5 mg/m2/day (maximum single dose 2 mg) once weekly Weeks 1-6 during radiation for

therapy and given weekly thereafter. Administer prior to CARBOplatin.
